findings.problem: The offer reads 'IO%'. Cormorant Garamond SemiBold renders old-style figures: the '1' renders 154 px tall at 400 px, which is x-height, and is an unflagged I-shape with symmetrical serifs. The '0' sits at x-height while the '%' is at full height. The hero therefore reads as small caps 'IO' next to a big '%', and on f290-f292 the '1' rises alone as a bare 'I'. The same thing happens at 60 px on the end card ('ıo% off'). This is the single most important line of the ad. Lining figures cannot be switched on through the tool, because openTypeFeatures is read-only in the Plugin API (plugin-api.d.ts:9774).
findings.fix: Set the numerals in the second family, which has lining figures. 1. Set S5/Ten/1, /0 and /% to Inter Semi Bold 300, LH 480 (unchanged, so the masks and the TRANSLATION_Y 480 keys stay valid), LS −4 %. 2. Re-measure and set each mask width to w_i + 52. The row is FIXED 952 CENTER, so it re-centres itself. 3. Nudge S5/Ten y (380 → about 398) so the baseline stays at screen 747, checked with absoluteRenderBounds. 'off' and 'your first order.' stay in Cormorant Medium Italic: a sans numeral against serif italic is a deliberate contrast and still uses only two families. 4. On the end card, set S4/10% off (42:15491) to Inter Semi Bold 50, re-measure w1, then recompute x1 = (952 − (w1 + 16 + w2))/2 − 8 and the 'your first order' mask x. Alternative if Cormorant must stay: replace the '1' and '0' text nodes with hand-drawn lining-figure vectors at cap height (about 225 px), keeping the same keys.

findings.problem: The image slit snaps shut in one frame instead of closing. HEIGHT runs 560 to 0 on IN, so it is about 298 px tall at f65 and 0 at f66, where the OPACITY guard also cuts. The last frame of the close carries 53% of the travel.
findings.fix: S1/Window HEIGHT: change the easing of the @2.2 0 key from IN to SOFT (cubic:0.45,0,0.55,1), which gives about 40 px at f65. The blur ramp (@2.1 0 L, @2.1667 10 SOFT) and the guard at f66 stay.

findings.problem: An overlap during the dive. As S2/Content scales up round the vase, the 230 px 'Ash Vase' headline rises into the band where the topmost Brand bug sits. At f177 the sharp ink 'Moku' sits between 'Ash' and 'Vase' and overlaps the 'V' ('Ash Moku Vase'). At f178 it sits on the cut-off headline. The z-order is as specified, but two wordmarks collide for 3 frames.
findings.fix: Fade the headline out before the collision. Add OPACITY to S2/Headline (a FRAME with resting opacity 1, currently unkeyed): @0 1, @5.6333 1 L, @5.8333 0 SOFT. The headline is gone by f175, and the vase photo carries the push alone.

findings.problem: The push-through brakes at the cut. It is not velocity-matched as the spec claims. S2's last visible step is x1.27 per frame (1.50 at f178, 1.91 at f179). S3's first step is x1.08 (0.82 at f180, 0.885 at f181). The blur drops from 18 to about 7 one frame after the cut. The forward motion visibly decelerates by about 3x across the cut.
findings.fix: Start S3 further back and drain its blur more slowly. S3/Content SCALE_XY: @0 0.66,0.66, @6 0.66,0.66 L, @6.5 1,1 OUT; the first step becomes x1.18, then x1.11. S3/Content effect:0:RADIUS: @0 18, @6 18 L, @6.3 0 OUT. S3/BG is not scaled, so no border appears.

findings.problem: The logo flight jumps mid-move. WHIP (cubic:0.83,0,0.17,1) over 13 frames puts a scale step from 1.63 to 2.37 and 102 px of TRANSLATION_Y into the single frame f339 to f340, with no blur. The sharpest element in the frame visibly pops halfway through its flight. The landing and the f346 logo swap are clean.
findings.fix: Spread the move: change the easing of the @11.5333 keys of Brand bug SCALE_XY (3,3) and TRANSLATION_Y (272) from WHIP to cubic:0.7,0,0.3,1. Alternatively, keep WHIP and fake the blur: figma_set_effects LAYER_BLUR radius 0 on Brand bug, then effect:0:RADIUS @0 0, @11.2667 0 L, @11.3333 6 SOFT, @11.4 0 SOFT (it returns to 0 well before the f346 swap).

findings.problem: The ripple is hidden, then too thin. S5/Ripple sits beneath S5/Field and starts at the pill's rest size (640 x 120). At f397 and f398 it is 640 and 671 wide while the punched pill is 686 and 691, so it is covered. It only clears the pill from f400, when its stroke has already thinned to 1.6, then 1.0 px and is fading. On ink, a 1-2 px terracotta hairline breaks into crawling dots after Instagram's re-encode. The CTA's final pulse loses its ring.

Both arrow nudges are 1-frame jumps. A 3-frame expo-out puts about 90% of the travel in the first frame: 0 to 12.6 px at f398 to f399, and 0 to 9 px at f414 to f415. They read as a twitch, not a nudge.

The arrow pops on instead of drawing. The shaft's OPACITY guard turns on at f350, when PATH_TRIM_END is already 0.75 (a 5-frame OUT). The head turns on at f353 already at 0.83. For three frames the label reads 'Shop the collection -' (a dash), then the head appears whole.
findings.fix: S5/Arrow shaft PATH_TRIM_END: @11.6333 0 L, @11.8667 1 DRAW (the guard stays at f350, where the shaft is then about 2% long). S5/Arrow head PATH_TRIM_END: @0 0, @11.8 0 L, @11.9667 1 DRAW. Move the head's OPACITY guard to @11.8083 0 L, @11.8283 1 L (on at f355).

findings.problem: A 1-frame speck. The Iris OPACITY guard turns on at f76 (2.5083 to 2.5283), while WIDTH and HEIGHT are still 2. A 2 x 2 px dark photo dot sits dead centre on the cream disc for one frame, before the iris jumps to about 287 px at f77.
findings.fix: Move the S1/Iris OPACITY guard one frame later: @0 0, @2.5417 0 L, @2.5617 1 L (on at f77). The close guard (@3.4417, @3.4617) stays.

findings.problem: The S2 drifts stop dead at 5.6, the same moment S2/Content's IN dive starts from zero velocity, so f168-f171 are nearly frozen. f169 is the stillest frame in the whole render (mean diff 0.04, max 6). The 'anticipation' is a stall.
findings.fix: Carry the drift through the start of the dive. S2/Push SCALE_XY: add @6.0 1.05,1.05 L after @5.6 1.04,1.04. S2/Type TRANSLATION_Y: add @6.0 -15 L after @5.6 -12.

findings.problem: The export is one frame longer than the timeline. The MP4 has 433 frames (f0-f432, 14.433 s) because Figma renders the t = 14.4 endpoint; the spec calls for 432 frames (f0-f431). f432 is only the logo drift continuing (diff 0.03 against f431), so it is clean but off-spec.
findings.fix: No keyframe change. Trim at delivery with ffmpeg -frames:v 432 (re-encode), or accept 14.433 s and correct the frame count in the spec's tempo and E.1 sections.

lens: MOTION CRAFT (senior After Effects motion designer)

findings.time: 1.2 s (f36, peak f38); 10.2 s (f306, peak f308); 13.2 s (f396, first change f397)
findings.problem: All three accent punches start on the beat, so the beat frame itself shows no change. 'down.' and '10%' use a symmetric 2-frame SWELL attack. Measured 'down.' width is 730 / 752 / 776 px on f36 / f37 / f38, so the peak lands 66 ms late. The '10%' white area also peaks on f308, not f306. The CTA pill first moves on f397. The hits read late against the grid, and the bar asks for punches on the beat.
findings.fix: Move each attack 2 frames earlier so the peak lands on the beat frame. S1/Down SCALE_XY: @0 1,1 L · @1.1333 1,1 L · @1.2 1.06,1.06 SWELL · @1.5333 1,1 OUT. S5/Ten SCALE_XY: @0 1,1 L · @10.1333 1,1 L · @10.2 1.06,1.06 SWELL · @10.5333 1,1 OUT. S5/Field and S5/CTA mask SCALE_XY: @13.1333 1,1 L · @13.2 1.08,1.08 OUT · @13.3667 0.985,0.985 SOFT · @13.5333 1,1 SOFT. Shift every S5/Ripple key (including its 13.2417/13.2617 opacity guard) and the first S5/Arrow nudge (13.2667/13.4/13.6) by -0.0667 s, so the ripple is still born at the pulse peak.

findings.layer: S2 · Ash Vase (47:2201) OPACITY, S1/Wheel (47:2188) SCALE_XY
findings.problem: The squeeze reverses for one frame right before the burst. Measured dot diameters: Ø96 (f105), Ø90 (f106), Ø84 (f107), Ø96 (f108), then a 432 px disc (f109). S2 switches on at f108 and draws its 96 px band window over S1's 84 px dot. So the dot grows 14 % for one frame when it should be at its tightest as it bursts. This is a small tick at the hero match cut.
findings.fix: Swap the scenes on the burst frame. S2 · Ash Vase OPACITY: @0 0 L · @3.6083 0 L · @3.6283 1 L · @6.0083 1 L · @6.0283 0 L, which is the same frame S1 · Hook switches off. Then continue the squeeze through f108 by appending @3.6 0.0909,0.0909 SOFT to S1/Wheel SCALE_XY (Ø80). The result is Ø 96 → 90 → 84 → 80 → 432.

findings.problem: 'Ash Vase' is the scene's 230 px hero type, and it leaves on a 6-frame OPACITY cross-fade. It is the only fade in the piece. Every other word ('down.', 'By hand.', '10% off') exits through its mask on IN with blur. The fade happens during the camera's wind-up and reads as a prototype fade.
findings.fix: Delete the S2/Headline OPACITY track and exit through the existing masks. S2/Ash TRANSLATION_Y: append @5.6 0 L · @5.7333 276 IN. S2/Ash effect:0:RADIUS: append @5.6 0 L · @5.6667 8 SOFT · @5.7333 0 L. Give S2/Vase/V, a, s and e the same keys, staggered +0.0333 s each: V 5.6333→5.7667, a 5.6667→5.8, s 5.7→5.8333, e 5.7333→5.8667. Everything clears by f176, as the fade does now, so nothing reaches the bug during the dive.

findings.problem: Both 3000 px circles scale to 1.35 (Ø4050), but the frame is already covered at Ø2900. The terracotta fills the frame on f283 while still accelerating (Ø 223 / 658 / 1684 / 2855 on f280-f283). The IRIS soft landing therefore happens entirely off-screen, so the bloom slams instead of landing, 5 frames before the 9.6 downbeat. After it, f284-f286 are a flat, dead field (frame diff 0.05 / 0.00 / 0.02) until the '1' shows on f287.
findings.fix: Set the last S3/Cream circle SCALE_XY key @9.5333 from 1.35 to 1.06,1.06, and the last S3/Terracotta circle SCALE_XY key @9.6 from 1.35 to 1.06,1.06. Computed terracotta diameters are then Ø 2242 / 2716 / 2964 on f283-f285, so the last corner closes while decelerating, on f285. The Brand bug flip on f283 stays covered (the bug needs about Ø2000). To leave no empty frame, start the '1' one frame earlier: S5/Ten/1 TRANSLATION_Y @9.5 480 L · @9.9 0 OUT, and move its blur keys by -0.0333 s (@9.5 0 · @9.5333 10 · @9.6333 0).

findings.problem: Each glyph reaches its -18 overshoot key on OUT over 0.3 s. Expo-out leaves a long tail at the apex: the '$' top sits at 872 / 872 / 871 / 874 px on f150-f153, then sinks 19-22 px over 3 frames. The overshoot reads as rise, stop, second drop, not as a spring settle.
findings.fix: Use a shorter, less front-loaded approach and a quicker return. S2/Price/$ TRANSLATION_Y: @0 264 L · @4.7667 264 L · @4.9667 -16 cubic:0.25,0.75,0.4,1 · @5.0667 4 SOFT · @5.1667 0 SOFT. Apply the same curve to S2/Price/4 shifted +0.0667 s (4.8333 / 5.0333 / 5.1333 / 5.2333) and to S2/Price/8 shifted +0.1333 s (4.9 / 5.1 / 5.2 / 5.3). Leave the blur keys unchanged.

findings.problem: The brand's flight into the logo is the hero move: TRANSLATION_Y 0→272 and SCALE_XY 1→3 over 11.1-11.5333 on cubic:0.7,0,0.3,1. At peak, the glyph edges travel 70-110 px per frame with no faked motion blur. Every other fast move in the piece has blur, so the logo strobes in crisp steps.
findings.fix: First run figma_set_effects on Brand bug to add one LAYER_BLUR with radius 0. Then key effect:0:RADIUS: @0 0 L · @11.2333 0 L · @11.3 4 SOFT · @11.3667 5 SOFT · @11.4667 0 SOFT. The peak falls on f340-f341 and the blur is back to 0 before the logo swap at 11.5083. Keep the values low, because the blur may render larger under the 3× scale.

findings.problem: After the build, the end card's only motion is a uniform SCALE_XY 1→1.035 LINEAR over 2.87 s (about 0.2 px per frame at the edges) plus the 12→20 logo tracking drift. Mean frame diff is 0.10, half of the breath's 0.22. With one uniform push there is no parallax, so the 0.8 s before the pulse and the last 0.73 s read as a freeze frame.
findings.fix: Add differential drift and keep the CTA anchored. S4/Logo TRANSLATION_Y: @0 0 L · @11.5333 0 L · @14.4 -22 LINEAR. On S4/URL and S4/Footer TRANSLATION_Y, append @14.4 8 LINEAR after their landing keys (12.4667 and 12.5333). The logo and footer then separate by about 30 px over 2.9 s (about 0.3 px per frame), on top of the 1.035 push, which keeps it restrained.

findings.layer: S3/Content (42:15263), S3/Type (42:15321), S3/Cream circle (42:15421), S3/Terracotta circle (42:15423)
findings.problem: The r1 'not dead' drift breaks the S3 grid. S3/Content scales 1 → 1.045 about the frame centre and S3/Type adds −40. The type column drifts from x 62–66 (f210) to x 47–51 (f274), about 17 px outside the 64 margin, and the arch goes to x 46. 'AUTUMN 2026' climbs from 59 px to 12 px below the 'Moku' bug (measured at f274: kicker y 360–382, bug 301–348). At the end of the scene's 2.8 s hold the kicker reads as part of the logo line, and the header hierarchy collapses.
findings.fix: Pivot the drift on the column's top-left (64,416) instead of the frame centre. S3/Content TRANSLATION_XY: add a last key, giving @0 -78,110 · @6 -78,110 L · @6.7 0,0 OUT · @9.6 21.4,24.5 L. The value is 0.045 × (476,544); SCALE_XY stays as it is, so both are LINEAR over 6.7–9.6. S3/Type TRANSLATION_Y: change the last key from @9.6 -40 to @9.6 -10. Move the rest positions of S3/Cream circle and S3/Terracotta circle by +18,+21 (x -1176 → -1158, y -262 → -241), so the bloom still seeds on the same spot of the bowl wall. Result: the left edge stays on x 64, the kicker stays at least 57 px below the bug, the arch bottom ends at about 1544 (inside 1580), and the right edge of 'Dinner Plates' ends at about 1000.

findings.layer: S2/Band window (42:15364), S2/Push (42:15365), S2/Plate clay (42:15376), S2/Plate terracotta (42:15377)
findings.problem: The band's top edge at y 540 cuts the 230 px 'Ash Vase' 31 px below its x-height (measured lowercase 509–601, baseline 600). Every lowercase letter carries a thin cream sliver on top. The lower two-thirds of 'ase' sit on the band grey (189,184,179), where terracotta measures 2.8:1, below the 3:1 floor for large text. On the product hero, held 1.5 s, the overlap reads as misregistration, not as a deliberate overlap.
findings.fix: Sit the baseline on the band edge: move the band top to y 600 (+60) and keep the photo screen-locked. S2/Band window: rest y 540 → 600; HEIGHT key @4.1 1040 → 980; TRANSLATION_XY @0 and @3.6 336,592 → 336,532 (the dot stays centred on 384,1180). S2/Push: rest y 0 → -60; TRANSLATION_XY @0 and @3.6 -336,-592 → -336,-532, so the vase, dimension line, ticks and '32 cm' do not move on screen. S2/Plate clay and S2/Plate terracotta: height 1040 → 980, rest y -1040 → -980; TRANSLATION_Y start value 1040 → 980 on both keys (@0 and @3.8 for clay, @0 and @3.7333 for terracotta). The whole headline then sits on cream (terracotta 5.2:1), and the vase rim keeps about 185 px of wall above it.

findings.problem: Past list items dim to opacity 0.35. Measured at f260 on linen: the names are 2.16:1 and the prices 1.83:1, which is illegible for 28–32 px Inter on a phone. 'Dinner Plates / $110 · set of 4' is readable at full contrast for only about 0.5 s (7.6–8.13): five words, about 0.1 s per word against the brief's 0.3 s floor. 'Kiln Mug / $32' gets 0.6 s. Two of the three collection prices never get a fair read.
findings.fix: Keep the timing and change the dim value from 0.35 to 0.6. S3/Name 1 OPACITY last key → @7.4 0.6 SOFT. S3/Price 1 → @7.4333 0.6 SOFT. S3/Name 2 → @8.3 0.6 SOFT. S3/Price 2 → @8.3333 0.6 SOFT. Names land at about 4:1 and prices at about 3.1:1. The active item (15:1) and the terracotta pointer still clearly lead, and the whole list stays readable until the bloom at 9.2.

findings.problem: 'first order.', and then 'order.' alone, are still inside S5/Field while it shrinks to pill proportions (about 300 px tall at f339). For 3–4 frames, just before 'Shop the collection' lands, the field reads as a terracotta button labelled 'order.'.
findings.fix: Start the exits earlier, staggered one frame behind 'off' (10.9333). S5/your TRANSLATION_Y: @10.9333 0 L · @11.1333 116 IN (was 11.0 / 11.2). S5/first: @10.9667 0 L · @11.1667 116 IN (was 11.0667 / 11.2667). S5/order.: @11.0 0 L · @11.2 116 IN (was 11.1333 / 11.3333). Every word is gone by f336, while the field is still about 1000 px tall. The offer line is restated on the end card from 12.4.

findings.problem: At full growth the ripple ring spans y 1011–1308 (measured at f408, opacity about 0.35). It cuts straight through 'moku.store' (1277–1304) and comes within 7 px of the offer row's descenders (1004). A terracotta line through the URL muddies the one line a viewer may need to type.
findings.fix: Contain the ripple between the offer row and the URL. Change these S5/Ripple keys @13.9: WIDTH 880 → 800, HEIGHT 300 → 200, TRANSLATION_XY -120,-90 → -80,-40, CORNER_RADIUS 150 → 100. Keep the birth at 692×130, STROKE_WEIGHT 8 → 1.5 and the FADE opacity. The ring ends at x 140–940, y 1060–1260: 56 px below the offer row and about 19 px above the drifting URL (top at about 1279 by 13.9).

findings.layer: S1/By hand (frame, rest 64,404); interacts with S1/Ring (42:15863)
findings.problem: The descender of 'By' (bottom y 561) hangs 23 px above the wheel ring (ring top y 584 at f91). At the ring's 1.02 overshoot (2.8 s) the gap is 9 px, right where the ring's trim starts at 12 o'clock. Meanwhile 'By hand.' has 81 px of air above it to the bug, so the line looks pressed onto the ring.
findings.fix: Move S1/By hand rest y 404 → 384 (−20). The glyphs land at y 409–541: 61 px below the bug baseline, 39 px above the ring at rest and 29 px at the overshoot. No keyframe change is needed; S1/By and S1/hand. translate inside their masks.

findings.layer: S4/Bowl arc (frame at 358,690, 364×48) / S4/Bowl arc path (42:15109)
findings.problem: The shallow upturned terracotta arc centred under the 'Moku' wordmark (y 687–733) reads as a smile, close to the Amazon swoosh, not as a bowl. It sits in the logo lockup on the frame held longest (2.4 s).
findings.fix: Make it a rule. Re-import SVG E1 as <svg width='200' height='4' viewBox='0 0 200 4'><path d='M2 2H198' stroke='#a4532f' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/></svg>. Place the wrapper as S4/Bowl arc at (440,708) and name the vector S4/Bowl arc path. Re-apply the same tracks unchanged: OPACITY @0 0 · @11.6083 0 L · @11.6283 1 L; PATH_TRIM_START @0 0.5 · @11.6 0.5 L · @12 0 DRAW; PATH_TRIM_END @0 0.5 · @11.6 0.5 L · @12 1 DRAW. It still draws centre-out on the beat, with 48 px clear above and 53 px clear below. If the ceramic reference must stay, use a true bowl section with a flat foot (about 220 × 70) instead, and move S4/Tagline down 24.

findings.layer: S2/Band window (42:15364), S2/Push (42:15365), S2/Plate clay (42:15376), S2/Plate terracotta (42:15377)
findings.problem: The anticipation pull-back (S2/Content 0.965 about 384,1180) shows the band's side edges. Cream slivers of 13 px and 24 px open on the left and right of a band that snapped to full bleed at 4.2. For about 8 frames it reads as a card shrinking, not as the camera pulling back.
findings.fix: Overscan the band by 40 px each side. S2/Band window: WIDTH key @4.1 1080 → 1160; TRANSLATION_XY key @4.1 0,0 → -40,0. S2/Push: TRANSLATION_XY key @4.1 0,0 → 40,0, which keeps the photo screen-locked. S2/Plate clay and S2/Plate terracotta: width 1080 → 1160. The dot start, the burst centre (540) and the 384,1180 pivot do not change. At 0.965 the edges sit at x −25 and 1094, outside the frame.

lens: Technical QA (finishing editor): frame-by-frame defects in moku-ig-story-ad-v2-r1.mp4. I checked every frame for diffs, ran region diffs on each handoff, measured pixels on the cut, swap, ripple and anticipation frames, and read back the motion context of 42:15039 (96 layers).

findings.problem: The ripple's bottom edge sweeps across the URL in the end card. The URL glyphs sit at y 1278-1304. The ring's lower edge (measured at x 380 and x 700) is at y 1283 on f401, 1291 on f402, 1297 on f403, 1301 on f404 and 1307 on f407, so it strikes through 'moku.store' at about 90 % opacity with a 5-6 px stroke on f401-f403, then fades over it. This is the only place in the piece where a graphic crosses live text, and it happens on the CTA beat. The cause is the final HEIGHT 300 with TRANSLATION_XY -120,-90: its bottom is at y 1310.
findings.fix: Change only the @13.9 end keys of S5/Ripple: WIDTH 880→820, HEIGHT 300→200, CORNER_RADIUS 150→100, TRANSLATION_XY -120,-90 → -90,-40. Keep the @13.2667 start keys (692×130, -26,-5, r65), the OUT easing, STROKE_WEIGHT 8→1.5 and the OPACITY FADE as they are. The centre stays at (540,1160) and the ring ends at x 130-950, y 1060-1260. That leaves at least 17 px above the URL glyphs (more as S4's 1.035 drift pushes the URL down) and about 60 px below the offer-row descenders (y ≈ 1000).

findings.problem: Something is left behind after the exit. A 2 px grey speck (value 221 on 248 cream) stays at screen (394-395, 404) for 5 frames: it is the anti-aliased tip of the 'y' descender sitting on the By mask's top edge after the TRANSLATION_Y exit to -158. It lies inside the dot-hold frames, where E.2 still #12 requires 'one crisp dot … nothing else', and only disappears when S2 covers it on f108. A pixel scan of f104-f107 finds nothing else on cream.
findings.fix: Add a frame-exact OPACITY guard to S1/By: @0 1 L · @3.4083 1 L · @3.4283 0 L, which turns it off from f103, the first frame where no other part of 'By' is still inside the mask. An alternative is to end the exit at -176 instead of -158 (@3.4333 -176 cubic:0.7,0,0.84,0), so the descender clears the mask edge by a full row.

findings.problem: The words pop off at the end of their exits. Both ride IN (cubic:0.7,0,0.84,0) to -158 with no blur. Each word rises only about 50 px over 5 frames (y = 0.31 at x = 0.83), then covers the remaining ~108 px in one sharp frame: 'By' is legible on f102 and gone on f103, 'hand.' is legible on f103 and gone on f104. Every other IN exit in the piece on the same curve (S1/Down letters, S5/Ten letters) carries a 10 px blur on its last frames, so these two read as cut off rather than whipped out.
findings.fix: Append exit blur keys to the existing effect:0:RADIUS tracks. S1/By: … @2.5667 0 SOFT · @3.3667 0 L · @3.4333 10 SOFT. S1/hand.: … @2.6333 0 SOFT · @3.4 0 L · @3.4667 10 SOFT. Translation keys stay unchanged. The guard from the previous finding still hides any residue after f103.

findings.layer: S2/Band window (47:2204), S2/Push (47:2205); squeeze on S1/Wheel (47:2188)
findings.problem: The dot handoff is not pixel-identical. S1/Wheel squeezes the dot 96 → 90 → 84 px (0.0955 on f107). On f108 S2 switches on with its Band window at Ø96, so the dot snaps back +12 px (14 %) for one frame before the burst on f109. In the dot region the diff is 15.4 on f108 against 7.5-8.2 on the squeeze frames. The spec's must-hold for f108 is 'identical to S1's last state'. Position is fine: centre (383,1180) on f105-f108.
findings.fix: Keep the squeeze and start S2 at the squeezed size. S2/Band window: WIDTH and HEIGHT @0 84 · @3.6 84 L (the @4.1 1080/1040 keys stay); CORNER_RADIUS @0 42 · @3.6 42 L (the 3.9 and 4.2 keys stay); TRANSLATION_XY @0 342,598 · @3.6 342,598 L. S2/Push: TRANSLATION_XY @0 -342,-598 · @3.6 -342,-598 L, so the photo stays screen-locked (same OUT curve, so the offsets cancel on every frame). The simpler alternative is to delete the S1/Wheel SCALE_XY key @3.5667 0.0955, so the dot holds at 96.

findings.layer: S2/Content (47:2203) anticipation; clip is S2/Band window (47:2204)
findings.problem: During the 0.965 anticipation pull-back, both ends of the full-bleed band become visible. Cream slivers appear down the band's left and right edges: 3/5 px on f167, 9/16 on f168, 13/24 on f171 and 9/17 on f174, gone from f176 (left/right, measured at y 1000). The vase photo is already overscanned (1400 wide at x -90 in S2/Push), so the 1080-wide Band window clip is what shows its edge.
findings.fix: Overscan the band window by 48 px. S2/Band window: @4.1 WIDTH 1128 (was 1080) and @4.1 TRANSLATION_XY -16,0 (was 0,0). S2/Push: @4.1 TRANSLATION_XY 16,0 (was 0,0), which compensates and keeps the photo and the Push pivot at (384,1180). Resize S2/Plate clay (47:2216) and S2/Plate terracotta (47:2217) to 1128 wide, keeping x 0. At 5.7 the band then maps to x -2 … 1086, so it stays past both frame edges, and the resting look after 4.2 is unchanged because the frame clips it.

findings.problem: Terracotta type crosses a terracotta plate. While the plate wipe is still clearing the top of the band, the terracotta italic 'V' (and then 'a') rises across it: the lower half of the 'V' disappears on f118, and a terracotta strip cuts through 'Va' on f119-f120. That is 3 frames where the headline's second word partly vanishes.

findings.problem: The push-through cut flashes white. This is the ad's only camera move. The whole-frame mean goes from RGB 178,174,164 on f179 to 242,236,226 on f180, a luma jump of about 59/255, with 97.7 % of pixels changing by more than 8 levels (frame diff 60.9). That is the largest single-frame discontinuity in the spot; every other big jump is a spatially continuous wipe. The zoom rate is matched (S2 x1.32 per frame into the cut, S3 x1.27 out), but the picture mass and tone are not. The IN curve back-loads S2's 2.6x key onto f180, which is never shown, so the last S2 frame is the vase at 1.735x, blurred, filling about 85 % of the frame. The next frame is a 260 px arch on flat linen. It reads as a hard cut plus a blink, not as a push through the vase belly.
findings.fix: Primary fix, a tonal bridge with no cross-fade: on S3/BG (42:15253), unbind color/bg/subtle (keyframed fills stay raw hex, spec 3.6) and key fill:0 @0 #b2aea4 · @6.0 #b2aea4 L · @6.3 #f4efe7 SOFT. #b2aea4 is f179's blurred average, so S3 rises out of the vase tone into linen while S3/Content's blur decays from 18 to 0 over the same 9 frames. (2) S2/Content: append SCALE_XY @6.0667 4.5,4.5 L, TRANSLATION_XY @6.0667 546,-770 L (T = (1-s)(-156,220), so the pivot stays on (384,1180)) and effect:0:RADIUS @6.0667 18 L. findings.problem: Both on-beat type punches are isosceles spikes, not punches with weight. Measured 'down.' width: 732, 754, 776 (f36), 755, 743, 737. The scale arrives at 1.06 on SWELL with zero velocity and leaves on OUT at maximum velocity, so the peak is a cusp and the move reads as a twitch. '10%' has the same keys.

The cut frame changes (diff 5.0 and 8.7), then the image holds on sub-pixel drift for 0.57 s (f225-242) and 0.67 s (f251-270), at diff 0.28-0.32. S3/Bowl SCALE_XY: @0 1.06,1.06 · @8.1 1.06,1.06 L · @8.3667 1,1 OUT · @9.6 1.04,1.04 L. The bowl is at about 1.027 at the 9.2 bloom seed, so the seed point moves by only a few px.

findings.problem: The burst is meant to read as a circle (spec E.2 #13: near-circle, radius ~514 at 3.9), but from f111 it renders as a horizontal stadium or rounded rectangle. TRANSLATION_XY: @0 336,532 · @3.6 336,532 L · @4.0333 50,0 OUT · @4.2 0,0 cubic:0.4,0,0.2,1 · @5.5 0,0 L · @5.5333 -40,0 L (the centre path stays 384,1180 -> 540,1090). findings.problem: These are the only frames the single-frame flicker scan flags. In each punch the peak is one frame, and the release moves as fast as the attack.
